⚡ **AVENGERS Piggy Flashes — October 26–27** ⚡

📊 **The Headline**
40 racers piled up **103,948 lines** across the four Flashes — **2,599 per racer**, up **3.0%** on the last-4-set average. PF2 brought the biggest pot at **2.47M Stars**, #9 of 13 PF2 pots in the Arena era.

🏆 **Flash Winners**
PF1 — INTEN (4,727) · PF2 — INTEN (4,242) · PF3 — Addicted (3,431) · PF4 — INTEN (3,676)
Plus second-lobby wins for STAR-LORD in PF2 and PF4!

👑 **INTEN Rewrites the Record Book**
INTEN's **12,645-line set** is the **#1 Flash Set total of all time**, topping his own 12,324 from Oct 6 — with three Flash wins along the way. CHEN1972 (7,906) and Lin (7,598) round out the podium.

🚀 **Personal Bests**
6 set-total PBs and 6 single-Flash PBs:
• Timmy — 2,470 set (+213.5%) and 1,692 in PF1 (+114.7%)
• 7-STAR — 3,458 in PF4 (+46.0%) and 5,037 set (+7.4%), a +236.1% jump on his own average
• SiFra — 7,204 set (+27.3%)
• Lin — 7,598 set (+15.6%) and 3,216 in PF1 (+14.3%)
• CHEN1972 — 7,906 set (+14.9%) and 3,214 in PF2 (+5.3%)
• no — 1,062 in PF3 (+4.6%)
• Pablin — 2,308 in PF3 (+1.5%)
23 of 39 set totals beat their own average.

👋 **New Face**
Welcome ShielDBreaker! 4,663 lines over three Flashes (best 1,695 in PF3) — #8 on the set board in his first Flash.

🎯 **Milestones**
5 racers cleared 5K, 3 cleared 7.5K and INTEN cleared 10K — the 7.5K+ and 10K+ counts tie for #3 in the Arena era.

Full results and PBs: https://avengersmobcontrol.github.io/avengers-stat-center/

🚀 **AVENGERS Space Race — October 30** 🚀

**📊 The Numbers**
40 racers covered **8,104.4B lightyears** — averaging **202.6B** per racer, up **+9.4%** on our last-4-race pace. Lobby 2 ran away with the week's standout pot: **15.74M Stars** (#12 all-time, #12 this Arena era)!

**🏆 Podium**
🥇 SweetiePL — 600.0B
🥈 Lin — 517.6B
🥉 7-STAR — 421.4B

**✨ Standout Stories**
Lin blew past his own PB by **+110.4%**, rocketing from 246.0B to **517.6B** (now #15 all-time, #15 this Arena era)! SweetiePL topped the race AND set a new PB at 600.0B (+25.0%, #7 all-time, #7 this Arena era). And I.S.O posted the single biggest jump over his own average tonight: **+219.3%**!

**🆕 New Face**
Welcome ShieldBreaker, debuting at 96.6B (Lobby 3, 8th place)!

**💪 Personal Bests**
6 new PBs, and 30 of 39 returning racers beat their own average:
1. Lin +110.4%
2. SweetiePL +25.0%
3. JefhKintz05 +13.4%
4. McNasty +11.8%
5. KNAVEN +4.5%
6. Fred +3.1%

**🎖️ Milestones**
600B+ this race: 1 racer — ties for the **2nd-best** Arena-era count ever in that tier! 500B+: 2 racers, tying for **3rd-best**.

**🙌 Effort Shoutout**
Biggest grind-for-less-reward: **no**, covering 141.1B at just **111.6 Sparks/B**!

Full results and PBs: https://avengersmobcontrol.github.io/avengers-stat-center/
